steps.title: Configure System Permissions in Android Manifest
steps.description: Add Internet, Foreground Service Media Playback, Wake Lock, Wi-Fi State, and Notification permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Enhance Custom WebView Engine for Screen Off Playback
steps.description: Override WebView window visibility, view focus, and onPause event hooks in BackgroundWebView.java so WebKit never suspends audio rendering when screen turns off.

steps.title: Implement Partial Wake Lock and Wi-Fi Streaming Lock
steps.description: Upgrade BackgroundAudioService.java with CPU Partial Wake Lock and Wi-Fi Lock to prevent network throttling and CPU sleep during screen lock.

steps.title: Implement WebKit Timers and Page Visibility JavaScript Injection
steps.description: Update Javascript injection in MainActivity.java to continuously override Page Visibility API, block pause events, and maintain background web media session.

steps.title: Implement Task Removal and Task Minimization Navigation
steps.description: Configure onTaskRemoved and moveTaskToBack in MainActivity to ensure background playback seamlessly continues when user swipes away or exits app.

steps.title: Register Screen Off and Lock Screen Broadcast Observers
steps.description: Register intent filters for ACTION_SCREEN_OFF, ACTION_SCREEN_ON, and USER_PRESENT to trigger JS audio keep-alive signals on screen lock state changes.

steps.title: Implement Foreground Media Session Notification Controls
steps.description: Ensure media playback notification state remains active and updated with metadata across lock screen controls.

steps.title: Building YouTube Background Player
steps.description: Compile final APK with screen lock and background audio continuation fixes.
